title: Loose note (memo, research log, ad-hoc record)
description: A flexible note that does not belong in an ADR, spec, plan or task. Use for short-lived or draft records. Promote to an ADR if it becomes important long term.

topic.description: One broad label, coarser than tags (for example, 'auth-flow' or 'perf-investigation').

summary.description: A one- or two-sentence summary for people/agents browsing the index.

expires.description: Date when the note is expected to become stale. After this date, consider transitioning its status to archived.

record_type.description: Record type under the dev-evidence history producer contract. Requires subject_paths when specified.

subject_paths.description: Repository-relative paths covered by the record. dev-evidence aggregates them into the history view.

outcome.description: Short conclusion (for example, refuted/confirmed for a debug experiment, or fixed/filed for a finding).
